name: core/login
description: Successful login, a second login on the same connection, and a session superseded by a new connection for the same user.

steps.note: success reply carries no id on the reference server (R19)
second login on one connection is rejected

same user from a new connection supersedes a1. The reference server queues a 401 notice for a1 and closes it right away, so the notice arrives only some of the time (hub.go Run register branch); Talkwire should flush it before closing.
snapshot reply carries no id on the reference server
